events.text:
All 12 integration tests pass. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

**`src/users.ts`**
- Added `validateExists(id)` helper that throws if a user is missing
- Guarded `create()` against duplicate IDs

**`src/tasks.ts`**
- Added user existence validation for `createdBy` and `assignee` on task creation
- Reject empty titles
- Implemented strict status transition machine: `open → in_progress → done`, with no backward/repeat transitions
- Added `userId` parameter to `delete()` with permission check via `canDelete()`
- Integrated `Cache` (set on `getTask`, invalidate on `updateStatus`/`delete`)
- Integrated `Audit` (`record` on `create`, `updateStatus`, `delete`)

**`src/permissions.ts`**
- `canDelete`: admin can delete any task; owner can delete own; others denied
- `canExport`: only admin role is allowed

**`src/cache.ts`**
- Changed `get()` to return `null` (not `undefined`) on miss/expiry
- Made the internal store static so all instances share state (required by cache invalidation test)
- Implemented `invalidate(key)` to delete entries

**`src/audit.ts`**
- Implemented `record()` to push entries into the log array

**`src/exporter.ts`**
- Checks `canExport` permission before allowing export
- Builds CSV with header `id,title,status,assignee,createdAt`
- Proper CSV escaping for commas, quotes, and newlines
- Records an `export` audit entry

**`src/index.ts`**
- Fixed re-export: added `create` alongside `create as createUser` so both import styles resolve correctly

Verified with `npx vitest run`: **12 tests passed**.
